title: Syncing Apple Music across your devices is easier than you think

claims.claim: Apple Music, Android telefonlar, Windows PC'ler ve akilli televizyonlar gibi farkli platformlarda kullanilabilir.

evidence.quote: You can, for example, sign in with your Apple Account and listen to your favorite songs on an Android phone, Windows PC or even smart TVs.

claims.claim: Apple Music uygulamasinda Sync Library ozelligi Android telefonlarda varsayilan olarak etkindir.

evidence.quote: If you have an Android phone, this option is enabled by default, and you don't need to change anything.

claims.claim: Mac uygulamasinda File menusunden Library altindaki Update Cloud Library secenegi secilerek bulut kutuphanesi guncellenebilir.

evidence.quote: In the Mac app, click the File menu, then go to Library and select Update Cloud Library — this will force the app to sync and check for updates in your personal library.

claims.claim: Apple Music uyesi degilseniz ve Mac veya PC'de cevrimdici bir kutuphaneniz varsa, Music klasorunu Apple iTunes veya Apple Devices araciligiyla manuel olarak aktarabilirsiniz.

evidence.quote: If you don't subscribe to Apple Music and have an offline library on your Mac or PC, the only way to sync your library is to manually transfer the Music folder to another computer via Apple iTunes or Apple Devices.

claims.claim: iPhone veya iPad'de ayarlardan Music uygulmasi bulunarak Sync Library etkinlestirilebilir.

evidence.quote: On your iPhone or iPad, open Settings and look for Apps. Then, find the Music app in the list and enable Sync Library.

claims.claim: Mac'te Music uygulamasinin ayarlari altindaki General sekmesinden Sync Library etkinlestirilebilir.

evidence.quote: On a Mac, open the Music app and click the "Music" menu at the top of the screen, then go to Settings. Now, under the General tab, make sure Sync Library is enabled and click OK to save your settings.
